Classic browser PWA (index.html + desktop/sources). Vendored as classic
scripts. Service worker dropped (the GIF is the cache). UDP/OSC operators
call require('dgram') / require('node-osc') — the browser stub logs and
they stay silent. Web MIDI is optional.

GifOS patch, clock.js only: upstream used a blob Worker for the 4-tick
timer. The sandbox has no worker-src, so the same interval runs on the
main thread. Everything else is unmodified source.

The grid is saved on this device. Press Invite to look together; each
person has their own canvas. Upstream wrote the grid to a .orca download
and remembered zoom/bpm in localStorage.
